subject: general
question:
This question based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 634 145 317 534 621 (Right)

(Example: 697 − first digit = 6, second digit = 9, third digit = 7)

NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.

What will be the resultant if the third digit of the largest number is added to the second digit of smallest number?
solution:
First we find the largest & the smallest numbers in the given series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0424337f585485825d202d30c9ae9553a03704ab48cc1f6ffd798cf2893481e5.png] 

 

Now we add the third digit of the largest number to the second digit of the smallest number,

Third digit of the largest number = 4

Second digit of the smallest number = 4

So, **4 + 4 = 8**

Hence, the correct answer is **" 8 ".**
